summary: V3.8.4 quality run is blocked because the Codex Runtime rejects uniqueItems in changedFiles schema

expected.behavior: The bound quality lifecycle should start the reviewer Runtime and proceed to scoped quality checks.
expected.contract: The structured output schema should be accepted by the configured Runtime provider.

actual.message: Invalid schema for response_format codex_output_schema: uniqueItems is not permitted under properties.changedFiles.

steps: Invoke the bound command h:engine quality V3.8.4.
Allow the lifecycle plan to start the cardworld-engine quality Run with the engine-delivery Profile and codex-cli-runtime.
Observe that Runtime startup fails while validating the structured output schema before the quality Feature executes.
Observe the stable failure code CODEX_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID and the message that uniqueItems is not permitted in changedFiles.

excerpts.text: Run status: all-remaining-blocked; feature quality/V3.8.4 is blocked; no findings or gates were recorded.

The blocker is in the external Harness Runtime contract, not in CardWorld source code; the workspace has no code changes.

missingEvidence: No compatible Runtime provider or upstream fix was available in this thread.
